description: This file is a test script written in shell that verifies the behavior of hook warning messages in a version control context, likely Git. It sets up test cases to check whether warnings are issued when hooks are ignored or not, and interacts with external scripts and Git commands.

methods.name: test_hook --setup
methods.description: Sets up a hook with the specified name and command.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets configuration variables for the test environment.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success POSIXPERM
methods.description: Defines a test case with POSIX permissions considerations.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern matches in the message output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
